  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, TotemColor totemColor)

      creates a Player instance given a nickname and a totemColor, while every other attribute is set to default

      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player, must not be null
      totemColor - the totem color of the player, must not be null

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, TotemColor totemColor, Tribe tribe, int numBottomPicksLeft, int numTopPicksLeft, int numSetCompleted, int addFoodStartOfRound, int addTopPick, int totalGatheringDiscount, int totalBuildingDiscount, int numStars, int numPrestigePoints, int numFood)

      creates a Player instance given all the attributes. Used in case of a game state reconstruction from a JSON file.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player, must not be null
      totemColor - the totem color of the player, must not be null
      tribe - the tribe of the player, must not be null
      numBottomPicksLeft - number of bottom picks left for this player, must be >= 0
      numTopPicksLeft - number of top picks left for this player, must be >= 0
      numSetCompleted - number of sets completed by this player, must be >= 0
      addFoodStartOfRound - amount of food added at the start of each round for this player, must be >= 0
      addTopPick - amount of top picks added for this player, must be >= 0
      totalGatheringDiscount - total gathering discount for this player, must be >= 0
      totalBuildingDiscount - total building discount for this player, must be >= 0
      numStars - number of stars for this player, must be >= 0
      numPrestigePoints - number of prestige points for this player, must be >= 0
      numFood - number of food for this player, must be >= 0
